//: Reviewed native-digit floors (§ verification): ~55% of the measured count on each number-dense fa route, so a regression that drops the page's own digits fails loudly while copy edits keep room to breathe.
//exempt: Reviewed EXEMPT CEILING: the measured 19.4% plus headroom. `data-lumo-latn` is the one thing that silences this gate — a page carrying ten real violations drops to one when a single attribute wraps it — and `latn-island-purity` cannot see that, because it fails an island hiding READER-SCRIPT prose while this hides Latin defects. So the exemption gets the same treatment as the digit count: a number a person reviewed, which may fall and may only rise on purpose. A docs site is legitimately code-heavy; that is why this is a per-site baseline and not a threshold in the rule.
//min: Reviewed MINIMUM DOCUMENT COUNT: 15 graded documents. The empty-directory refusal catches a build that produced nothing; this catches the likelier accident, a build that produced SOME of its pages — the gate would otherwise grade the survivors, find them clean, and report success while the pages that would have failed were never built. It was 16 until zero-delay redirect stubs stopped being graded, which is the deliberate drop this comment exists to record. Lower it in the same commit that removes a page.
